verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Hightouch serves an llms.txt at hightouch.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the product, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 document is also published and backs the rendered API reference, which gives agents structured API docs. However, the visible llms.txt content reads like a marketing summary, and the /docs.md probe returned 404, so markdown docs for agents are not evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes the full docs, an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these files.
